system.description: The capacity to fill a space - to command attention, assert presence, and make yourself impossible to ignore. Dominate is the opposite of Stealth: it is the skill of being the loudest, most visible, most compelling thing in the room, whether through force of personality, volume, physical authority, or sheer refusal to be overlooked. In a crisis, Dominate is what holds a crowd together, breaks a standoff, or creates the distraction that everyone else needs.
system.overcome: Use Dominate to take command of a chaotic group, be heard and heeded above competing noise, stare down an immediate physical threat, command an animal, or project enough authority that someone backs down.
system.caa: Use Dominate to establish aspects on a scene that reflect your presence having changed the social or physical dynamics - Nobody Is Moving, All Eyes On You, He's Not Sure Enough of Himself to Push It.
system.attack: Dominate can be used to make a social or psychological attack - an act of pure, directed intimidation that creates mental stress.
system.defend: By default, you can't defend with Dominate, except via an appropriate stunt.
